notes.title: Patch 0.3.5.0 Live for Testing #2
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732938/f87718632d4ed2a68eb91485f5b7a8464ad66471.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hey, GZW Community,

Thanks everyone for testing [b]Patch 0.3.5.0[/b] and providing us with your valuable [b]feedback[/b]. We’ve updated the build on the [b]public-test branch[/b], and the Patch is now live again for continued testing.

This patch brings [b]significant changes to the game[/b], along with [b]fixes for numerous community-reported issues[/b]. [/p][p][/p][h3]Main improvements to test:[/h3][list][*][p]Performance & Client Crashes after the UE 5.5 upgrade[/p][/*][*][p]Improved AI Aiming[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon Sway Tweaks[/p][/*][/list][p]You can find the complete [b]CHANGELOG[/b] below. [i](Please note: some details may still change before the patch goes live.)[/i]
[/p][h2]Public Testing Changelog \[Not Final][/h2][p][/p][h3]Key Enhancements and Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Focus on optimizing the movement animations in the 1st person perspective in various ways:[/p][list][*][p]Reduced several animations affecting the 1st person perspective, reducing excessive character movement and animation blending. For example, the top half of the character’s body was decoupled from the 1st perspective animations, and the breath animation was disabled in the 1st person perspective.[/p][/*][*][p]The weapon sway was adjusted, making it more responsive when the player moves[/p][/*][*][p]Pistol recoil has been tweaked to make it more realistic[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New and improved death sequence from the 1st person perspective. The player’s vision turns to the approximate direction from which the player was shot.[/p][/*][*][p]AI aiming rebalancing: The new system simulates human-like aiming behavior that varies based on AI difficulty level, combat situation, injuries, suppression, weather conditions, distance to the target, and weapon type.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Unreal Engine to version 5.5
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Most important changes and fixes reported by and requested by the community[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where lasers were not working correctly in specific locations, such as YBL-1 and parts of Midnight Sapphire[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the key drop frequency in Fort Narith to be incorrectly low[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the gunshot sounds where the sonic crack can be heard before the gunshot[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing Twitch drops rewards for players who were unable to claim them until now[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing very dark nights with the global illumination set to medium or higher[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players would get stuck under the ground or would fall through the map after getting revived[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the disabled FSR frame generation on RX580 graphics cards
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Gameplay[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where players always died if they got into a coma while in a helicopter[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where using the splint didn't prioritize the most damaged bone[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the extraction range for the squad strike Fragile Goods from 2,5m to 25m to allow for easier completion of the task[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare issue where blood stops regenerating after healing all wounds[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player's weapon can become invisible after examining another player with a grenade in hand[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the RIS II 12 Handguard compatibility with shorter barrels[/p][/*][*][p]Added the missing FDE AK Handguard to the military firearms box loot table[/p][/*][*][p]Added the missing HP Bunker key to the Hunter's Paradise Boss loot table
[/p][/*][/list][h3]World[/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted the ground assets in the Spielberk COP to prevent climbing on top of the roof[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the area on top of the Crusader COP, which was previously not recognized as a part of the COP area[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a missing collision on a wall near the Tiger Bay Central South East entrance[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the clouds were sometimes moving too fast[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the incorrect collision around fountains in the Midnight Sapphire that caused grenades to bounce off[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several locations where players could get stuck: [/p][list][*][p]Tiger Bay Wrecking Yard at 195, 130[/p][/*][*][p]Fanny Paradise - between a house and some pallets at 189, 121[/p][/*][*][p]In rocks near Sabai Lake Restaurant at 204, 152[/p][/*][*][p]In rocks near Inthavong Farm at 159, 133[/p][/*][*][p]Near Sawmill, between logs and a container at 138, 143[/p][/*][*][p]Outside of the Nomad COP at 189, 157[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled lights that were unintentionally on during the daytime[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an obsolete interaction option on a light switch in YBL-1
[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]UI[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an incorrect "joined squad" notification when a player was promoted to the squad leader[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a messenger channel would get stuck in the pinned section after unpinning[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the messenger window would fail to display when sending a message through the player interaction panel[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the option to invite to a squad from offline friends in the friend list[/p][/*][*][p]Faction kill is now pre-selected as the reason in the reporting window when reporting a player for a faction kill[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the incorrect text wrapping in the feedback form text window[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the incorrect DLC message wrapping in Czech[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the conflict zone details in the Spanish localization[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the conflict zone detail text not updating when changing the game language[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the incorrect size of the maintenance notification widget in the main menu[/p][/*][*][p]Unified the position of the maintenance window on various resolutions/screen sizes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the character level was displayed as zero instead of 1 after a wipe[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an empty icon in the hair section of the character creation screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing the weather forecast in the main menu to be out of sync with the in-game one
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Custom Servers[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player count was not greyed out when a custom server was running[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed wrong wording on the player list on custom servers[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented support for gamepad control for the free cam on custom servers[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players who join a custom server for the first time have "Nickname" displayed instead of their username[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player's rank was not set correctly on custom servers despite using the Everything Unlocked preset
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Technical and performance fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Various performance, RAM, and VRAM optimizations[/p][/*][*][p]Numerous crash fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the suggested default settings based on the player’s hardware[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where closing the game by pressing ALT+F4 might lead to the game freezing[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused the Load Friends Failed error if a player accumulated over 100 friends[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Steam friends data was not loaded after 60 minutes in the main menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players were unable to join the server as a squad leader under specific circumstances
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Technical Updates[/h3][list][*][p]Updated Oodle to 2.9.14 to workaround crashes related to specific Intel CPUs[/p][/*][*][p]Updated DLSS to 8.1.0[/p][/*][/list][p]Updated Epic Online Services SDK to version 1.17.1.3

Compared to Patch 0.3.5.0 Testing #1, we improved [b]the analytics data[/b] we’re gathering on performance and crashes and applied a [b]few additional fixes[/b]. [/p][p][/p][h3]Additional Changelog compared to Patch 0.3.5.0 Testing #1:[/h3][list][*][p][b]\[Fixed][/b] Incomplete weapon shadow on the ground[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Fixed][/b] Black artifacts sometimes appearing when using NVGs with the XeSS upscaling method[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Fixed][/b] Choppy sprinting animation transition when repeatedly pressing the Shift key[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Fixed][/b] Splints not healing damaged bones under certain circumstances[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Fixed][/b] Noticeable bump after stopping in the dynamic crouch animation[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Fixed][/b] Weapon becoming invisible in 1PV after being revived from a coma while holding a grenade[/p][/*][/list][p] We will continue working on fixes based on your feedback.

[/p][h2]Instructions & Feedback Form[/h2][p]We have a new feedback form. Please read the instructions carefully and complete the form once you finish your playtest: [url="https://forms.gle/PXfF32Xpak6xHrg56"]https://forms.gle/PXfF32Xpak6xHrg56[/url][/p][p] [/p][h3]Available servers:[/h3][list][*][p]EU West[/p][/*][*][p]US East[/p][/*][*][p]US West[/p][/*][/list][h3]Modes:[/h3][list][*][p]Warfare (PvEvP)[/p][/*][*][p]Joint Ops (PvE)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]In this public test, you will have [b]adjusted progression[/b], but your live progression will not be affected. 
[/p][h2]How to join?[/h2][olist][*][p] Go offline and online in Steam (via the Steam tab in the upper left corner). [/p][/*][*][p] Right-click on Gray Zone Warfare and select "Properties." [/p][/*][*][p] In the "Betas" tab, click on "none" ("Beta Participation" section) and select "public-experimental." server [/p][/*][*][p] Update the game. [/p][/*][/olist][p]Feel free to discuss in the public-test-chat channel on our [url="https://discord.gg/grayzonewarfare"]Discord[/url]. Playtest will last for a few days. [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued feedback and bug reports, they’re vital to making Gray Zone Warfare better with every update. 

Every Move Matters,
MADFINGER Games Team[/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.3.1.0 Now Live - Changelog
notes.notes:
Hey, GZW Community,

[b]Patch 0.3.1.0[/b] is now live on the [b]public [/b]branch. Download the update and dive in.

This patch includes over a hundred improvements and fixes based on the early feedback we have received. Notable changes include tweaks to the [b]NVGs[/b], the [b]Operator VO volume[/b], or [b]VRAM leak [/b]reductions.

We’re truly grateful for your feedback from the Experimental Testing, which has confirmed that the fixes are working as intended. Of course, we’re not stopping here. We’ll be addressing additional issues in upcoming hotfixes and patches.

[h1]Changelog:[/h1]
[h2]AI[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the AI navigation failed around specific doors in the starter towns' Town halls
[*] Fixed a rare issue where the AI NPCs might glitch through closed doors
[*] [b]Fixed an issue where AI NPCs were twitching and sliding when walking over uneven terrain[/b]
[/list]
[h2]User Interface[/h2]
[list]
[b][*] Fixed an issue where mortar hits incorrectly spawned new Conflict Zones
[*] Fixed an issue where the death screen might display incorrect info under specific circumstances[/b]
[*] Fixed an issue where the weapon stats were not updated in real time when a player has the weapon detail window opened and gets shot
[*] Fixed an intermittent issue where the minimap stayed open after respawning
[*] Improved the messenger UI for better clarity
[*] Adjusted the scale of some items in the details window 
[*] Fixed the maintenance notification message that incorrectly stated that the client was incompatible
[*] Fixed the maintenance screen to be displayed to players in the game menu when the maintenance starts
[*] Fixed a rare issue where the night was extremely dark under specific circumstances
[*] Fixed excessive image noise when using NVGs with Global Illumination set to low
[*] Fixed the incorrect text on the .300 AAC Blackout ammunition
[*] Fixed the visibility of waypoints placed in a conflict zone
[/list]
[h2]Weapons, gear & weapon parts[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the incorrect inventory size of the M9A1 9X19MM 30-Round Magazine
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented attaching tactical devices to the BM-1 AKM Accessory mount
[*] Weapon modifiers that have no impact on the weapon stats are now hidden
[*] Fixed the rear iron sight from clipping with NVGs
[*] Fixed an incorrect short name on the .300 blackout ammo
[*] Fixed missing water protection on the Exfil and LSHZ 1+ (multicam) helmets
[*] Fixed an issue where the iron sights were not updating properly when changing the iron sights' state
[b][*] Adjusted NVGs to have less visual noise and a brighter image; decreased the zoom level[/b][*] Scoping with NVGs will now force canting when selected scopes are attached to a rifle
[*] Fixed an issue where raindrops outside of the NVG view were also highlighted
[*] Fixed a missing string on the SVD Chassis MK1 handguard bottom rear keymod slot
[/list]
[h2]Localization[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where an incorrect language was displayed in the language selector under specific circumstances
[*] Fixed missing localization on the seasonal wipe screen
[*] Fixed missing localization of some parts of the custom server menu
[*] Fixed multiple minor localization issues
[*] Fixed multiple instances of missing localization in game settings
[*] Fixed the incorrect localization of specific server names for the Spanish language
[*] Fixed an issue where the option to unlock doors with a key was missing when the game language was set to Italian
[/list]
[h2]World[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a misplaced invisible collision in Fort Narith
[*] Fixed an incorrect collision of a clothline in Tiget Bay
[*] Fixed several minor incorrect collisions in the starter towns
[*] Fixed the position of several spawn points that were placed too close to COPs
[*] Fixed misplaced black trash containers around the world
[*] Fixed a spot in the FOB where players could get stuck between a wall and a lamp
[*] Fixed various spots in a warehouse at Tiger Bay where players might get stuck
[*] Fixed a spot near the Spielberk COP where players could get stuck
[*] Fixed a spot in Sunset Chalet where players could get stuck
[*] Fixed a spot behind a box in Tiger Bay near UNLRA Refugee Camp where players could get stuck
[*] Fixed a rare issue where the skybox light changed suddenly
[*] Fixed the lounger seats on top of the main FOB building, which reacted to the wind
[*] Adjusted the collisions of stones on a road, which caused rough movement 
[*] Fixed a tree that was clipping with the flag in the Atlas COP, making it hard to distinguish which faction held the COP
[*] Fixed an issue where the COP flag color was only visible to enemy faction players within 100 meters of it
[*] Fixed impenetrable glass on the Fort Narith HQ building
[*] [b]Adjusted the November 1, Julia 2, and Delta 1 LZs to provide more cover[/b]
[*] Fixed indoor flags incorrectly reacting to wind
[*] Fixed missing glass on a van's rear lights
[*] Fixed stretched textures on static dead bodies near the Sawmill
[*] Fixed an impenetrable cloth hanging at an employee’s house in Midnight Sapphire
[*] Fixed an issue where gazeebo lamps in the FOB were not destroyed completely when shot
[*] Fixed missing reflections on the water surface when wading through a lake
[*] Fixed the campfire visual effect
[/list]
[h2]Health system & health screen[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where dragging other players and kicking doors didn't drain stamina
[*] Fixed an issue that caused energy and hydration to be drained in captured COPs
[*] Fixed an issue where a fatal wound was displayed incorrectly if a player first went into a coma and then was killed
[*] Fixed an issue where wounds on body parts not protected with armor were displaying as stopped by armor
[/list]
[h2]Animations[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed unintended bolt movement during load animations of Type 51 and Glock
[*] Fixed a finger clipping through the weapon during the MP7 weapon check animation when the magazine is not attached
[*] Fixed an unnatural bend of the left index finger during the Beretta animations
[*] Fixed an unnatural shake during the Mossberg 590 during the empty reload animation in prone
[*] Fixed an issue where performing an animation didn't interrupt the COP capture progression bar
[*] Fixed an issue where pressing the right mouse button while sprinting could blur the screen and slow down the movement
[*] Fixed a visual desync between clients where one of the players is injured
[/list]
[h2]Tasks & Strike missions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the container location in the Muddy Buddy task
[*] [b]Fixed an issue where the squad strike mission Weapon Redistribution couldn't be finished[/b]
[*] Changed the location of the task item required for the task King of the Crossroads so that it doesn't require a key
[*] [b]Fixed an issue where squad striker missions failed automatically if a squad member was dead when the squad leader accepted the mission[/b]
[*] Fixed an incorrect task notification after reconnecting to the server
[*] Fixed task notification for auto-accepted tasks that appeared every time players connected to a server
[/list]
[h2]Custom servers[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the invite code to a customer server got overwritten when switching tabs in the settings menu
[*] Fixed a connection error after shutting down a custom server
[*] Fixed the restart process for custom servers that resulted in a network error

[h2]Other fixes[/h2]

[*] Fixed an issue causing occasional rubberbanding when wading in water
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed items inside the plate carriers to be manipulated during repairs
[*] [b]Fixed a VRAM leak during longer play sessions[/b]
[*] Removed selected caps from Banshee’s stock that were not intended to be for sale
[*] [b]Adjusted the range for mortar strike announcements[/b]
[*] Update FSR to 3.1.3a
[*] Fixed an issue causing raindrops to appear black when falling on a car windshield
[*] Fixed an issue where players couldn't rejoin a full server if they were kicked for inactivity
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the Twitch rewards to be overwritten and displayed as already claimed if the player received other rewards before claiming them
[*] Fixed a rare issue where the pain sound is played repeatedly under specific circumstances
[*] The game window will no longer be minimized when pressing the F11 key
[*] Adjusted the operator voice-over volume level
[/list]

If you encounter any further issues, please report them to our Customer Care. Your bug reports and feedback are invaluable in helping us improve Gray Zone Warfare: [url=https://support.madfingergames.com/hc/en-us/requests/new]https://support.madfingergames.com/hc/en-us/requests/new[/url]

We’re committed to continually enhancing the Gray Zone Warfare experience and will keep working to improve the game. Development updates will be shared along the way, so stay tuned. Thank you for being part of this Early Access journey with us!

Every Move Matters,

notes.title: Update 0.3 – Winds of War Changelog
notes.notes:
Hello, GZW Community, 

[h3][b]Winds of War, the second major update for Gray Zone Warfare, will be released today[/b]. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732938/4f49a711f058e16deedc1110ffd080356c20bc95.jpg[/img]

Built on community feedback, this update brings fresh content and meaningful improvements for both PvE and PvP players. Experience deeper immersion with a [b]dynamic weather system[/b], take on new challenges across [b]expanded locations[/b], enjoy more variety with new [b]weapons [/b]and [b]gear[/b], and benefit from a smoother gameplay experience through key[b] quality-of-life upgrades.[/b]

We've been closely monitoring reactions to the Winds of War Early Preview and made adjustments based on your input to improve the final release build. Nevertheless, expect patches, hotfixes, and ongoing improvements as we continue to refine the game together.

[u]Find the [b] complete CHANGELOG below[/b].[/u]

We’re dedicated to making Gray Zone Warfare the best it can be, and your [b]feedback [/b]is vital in shaping its future. Share your experiences, thoughts, or any issues you encounter. Please report issues directly to [url=https://support.madfingergames.com/hc/en-us/requests/new]Customer Care[/url]—we’re here to help. To engage with the dev team and community, you can also connect with us on [url=https://discord.gg/grayzonewarfare]Discord[/url]. 

If you missed it, we’ve also enhanced the Gray Zone Warfare [b]editions[/b], unlocking essential gear and tools for a smoother start in the relentless open world while giving you a chance to support the game’s development. For more details, check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2479810/view/518588414413504684]this article[/url].

The storm has arrived. Will you rise with it?

Every Move Matters, 

MADFINGER Games Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732938/98359d6a47f6171e29034dcf50b3fdcaac04367a.jpg[/img]
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[u][b]IMPORTANT NOTE FOR NVIDIA USERS:[/b][/u] [b]We are currently experiencing a crash on startup on NVIDIA driver version 576.40 for most 50-series users. It is highly recommended that you stay on the previous versions or download a known stable driver version 576.28. We are working with NVIDIA to resolve the crash in the upcoming driver release. We are sorry for the inconvenience. [/b]

[h1]New features[/h1]
[h3]Realistic weather system[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dynamic weather conditions, including rain, storms, fog, and wind, both during the day and at night
[*] Rice fields fill up with water during rainy weather
[*] The weather forecast is shown on the map and in the main menu and is based on real weather data
[*] Player characters react to the changing weather conditions - hydration and energy deplete faster in a hot and humid environment
[*] NPCs are also affected - wind and rain affect their hearing, while rain and fog affect their sight[/list]
[h3]Conflict Zones[/h3]
[list]
[*] Get alerted about ongoing PVP conflicts on the map
[*] Conflict Zones are created on the map when PMCs from different factions engage in a fight 
[*] Conflict Zones stay on the map for a specific period of time, alerting players that a PVP fight is going on at this location
[*] Conflict Zones will disappear some time after the active firefight ends[/list]
[h3]Friend or Foe[/h3]
[list]
[*] An improved system to detect friendly players in a fight and prevent accidental friendly fire
[*] Players of the same faction will have a visible armband on their arm to signal that they are friendly
[*] Enemy PMC players will have no armband visible, signifying they are an enemy
[*] An operator will warn players that a friendly player is in the area [/list]
[h3]Tracking Tags[/h3]
[list]
[*] Purchasable trackers to help you track your gear.
[*] We are adding the tracking tags to the game based on community feedback. Thank you for sharing your suggestions!  
[*] Tracking tags can be attached to equipment to track its position on the map - helpful in retrieving your body, for example
[*] If a player loots a piece of gear with a tracker attached, their position will be tracked as they move with the tagged equipment in their player inventory until the tracker duration expires
[*] Trackers cannot be removed from the tracked items, so be careful what you loot and watch your back![/list]
[h3]Dragging bodies[/h3]
[list]
[*] Drag your downed squadmate to a more favorable position before attending to their wounds in safety[/list]
[h3]Mortars[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mortars make a comeback with a boom! Use them on the offense to support your attack run
[*] High-explosive mortar rounds can be found in the world or purchased from vendors, but they are very expensive
[*] Mortar strikes can be called to any location within a specific range (limited, so players cannot call mortar strikes at enemy FOBs)
[*] The time delay between the mortar strike being fired and the mortar shell landing is based on the distance
[*] Cannot be called to a location that is in proximity to friendly faction members[/list]
[h3]New vendor - Vulture[/h3]
[list]
[*] This vendor is available at random at two of the major COPs to the faction that holds the outpost
[*] He sells items that have been lost by other players and despawned from the world, and some items that are not available at regular vendors [/list]
[h3]New weapons[/h3]
[list]
[*] SVD
[*] MP7
[*] Sig MCX
[*] Beretta M9A1
[*] Colt Combat Commander [/list]
[h1]Experimental features[/h1]
We introduce these features in their first iterations and want you to share your feedback - what you like about them, what you might not agree with, and what you would like to see improved. 
[h3]Combat Outposts - COPs[/h3]
[list]
[*] New points of interest on the map that bring perks to the faction controlling them
[*] Guarded by neutral NPC guards until captured
[*] PVP implementation:
[list]
[*] Players can capture COPs for their faction
[*] Once captured by a faction, the COP is defended by the faction's NPC guards, who are hostile to other factions
[*] Can be recaptured by another faction
[*] Only one faction can hold it[/list]
[*] PVE implementation:
[list]
[*] Any faction can claim COPs by defeating the hostile NPC guards
[*] COPs can be shared between factions[/list]
[*]Two levels:
[list]
[*] Minor COPs
[list]
[*] Captured COPs can be used as respawn points instead of base camps (base camp respawn is still available)
[*] Players can choose to respawn at the nearest COP or the base camp
[*] Players can access the locker and vendors in the COP[/list]
[*] Major COPs
[list]
[*] Same as minor, but with heavier defenses, harder to capture
[*] In addition, a special vendor (more info below) is available at two random major COPs on the map. The controlling faction will have access to his services.[/list] [/list][/list]
[h3]Squad Strike Missions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Strike missions are a new addition that offers players a new way to progress through the game and creates a dynamic and unpredictable gameplay loop outside of the main campaign progression
[*] Strike missions appear randomly around the map and must be completed within a time limit
[*] They require players to be in a squad to accept and complete[/list]
[h3]Localization[/h3]
[list]
[*] We are bringing the game to new audiences by localizing it to the following languages:
[list]
[*] German
[*] French
[*] Portuguese (Brazilian)
[*] Spanish
[*] Italian
[*] Polish
[*] Czech
[*] Turkish
[*] Chinese (Simplified)
[*] Korean
[*] Japanese[/list]
[*]As always, if you encounter something not quite right (if a line is not appropriately localized to your language, or the text doesn't fit a button perfectly) let us know via the in-game feedback form or on our Discord.[/list]
[h1]Other gameplay changes[/h1]
[h3]Repair system overhaul[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed durability loss on coma and death
[*] Durability is now affected solely by use and is amplified when bullets hit the weapon
[*] New repair mechanics give you a choice in how you want to approach maintaining your gear
[list]
[*] Slow repair is the more cost-effective way of preparing your gear, but the repaired item remains unusable during the process
[*] New repair kits provide an instant repair but come at a higher price [/list][/list]
[h3]Destructible light sources in the world[/h3]
[list]
[*] Shoot out lights to gain an edge in night combat[/list]
[h3]Health system improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Guts
[list]
[*] Guts are now an organ in the lower abdomen, and will cause a coma if destroyed
[*] Resolves the issue with AI surviving a high amount of shots to the lower abdomen due to a lack of vital organ placement in this area[/list]
[*] Updated health symptoms - sore arms, upset stomach, cramps, vomiting, tremors, and fainting
[*] More details about injuries on the health screen of the player and for enemies
[list]
[*] Information about the damage source (knife, bullet, barbed wire, etc.) is displayed
[*] If the source of an injury is a bullet, the ammo type, the armor penetration status, and the shot's direction are shown
[*] A new bleeding effect - blood drops on the ground when you're injured
[*] The fatal hit is highlighted[/list][/list]
[h3]Tasks[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tasks can be managed outside of the FOB
[list]
[*] We are improving the game flow by allowing you to accept and finish selected tasks anywhere on the map. This change will also help with managing the travel time and easing the helicopter system
[*] Task rewards can now also be claimed outside of the FOB [/list]
[*]Kill tasks have shared progression in a squad
[list]
[*] Tasks that require players to kill a specific number of enemies now have shared progression for all members of the squad[/list]
[*] New tasks and reworked tasks, new task types
[list]
[*] Updated tasks are marked to let players know they shouldn't approach them in the same way as before[/list][/list]
[h3]Progression improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Experience awarded for killing enemy PMCs (if the kill happens within a conflict zone)
[*] Economy rebalancing
[*] Changes to restocking
[*] Improvements to looting

notes.notes:
Hey, GZW Community,

[b]Patch 0.2.4.0[/b] is now live on the [b]public [/b]branch. Download the update and dive in.

This patch addresses several key issues reported by the community. We want to extend a big thank you for the strong interest and the volume of feedback shared during testing — it’s been incredibly valuable.

Your input helped confirm that many of the fixes are working as intended, and also brought to light additional issues we’ll be addressing in future updates.

[h1]Changelog:[/h1]

[h2] Server Time Adjustment [/h2]
[list]
[*]Server times are now offset in all regions. This means connecting to a different region will allow you to connect to a server with a different in-game time of day to help with time-limited tasks. [/list]
[h2]Crash fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a crash caused by unplugging a microphone while no other audio input was connected to the player's PC
[*]Fixed a crash on the vendor trading screen
[*]Fixed a crash caused by a very specific chain of events - by removing critical weapon parts from a weapon that is currently equipped on a player in a coma and then using the weapon [/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
‎ 
‎ 
[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue which caused a player's latest body to become unlootable if the player disconnected from the game after dying
[*]Fixed a rare issue that allowed players revived from a coma to use an incomplete weapon (and cause a crash) 
[*]Fixed two possible exploits that allowed the nesting of an infinite number of containers
[/list]
[h3]Repairs[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue causing players to be unable to toggle a tactical device on or off after repairing a weapon
[*]Fixed a rare issue where players were unable to sell weapon parts after repairing a weapon
[*]Removed the repair button from the item detail window of items without durability [/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed the latency calculation on the latency warning icon to only measure actual connection latency as intended
[*]Fixed a rare issue causing players to be unable to attach a weapon part to a weapon by dragging it directly into a weapon slot [/list]
[h3]Tech[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a memory leak, which might result in excessive VRAM usage after re-entering the game
[*]Increased the reconnection grace period to 10 minutes. Players will now have more time to reconnect to the game before their character is reset. [/list]

If you encounter any further issues, please report them to our Customer Care. Your bug reports and feedback are invaluable in helping us improve Gray Zone Warfare: [url=https://support.madfingergames.com/hc/en-us/requests/new]https://support.madfingergames.com/hc/en-us/requests/new[/url]

We’re committed to continually enhancing the Gray Zone Warfare experience and will keep working to improve the game. Development updates will be shared along the way, so stay tuned. Thank you for being part of this Early Access journey with us!

Every Move Matters,
MADFINGER Games Team

As part of our ongoing efforts to optimize Gray Zone Warfare, we have identified an issue with Lumen’s Async Compute within the Unreal Engine that was responsible for a significant number of GPU crashes. This has now been resolved, resulting in improved system stability and a reduction in crash occurrences.

[h3]CHANGES [/h3]
[list]
[*]Disabled Lumen's Async Compute within the Unreal Engine to prevent GPU crashes related to this feature. 
[/list]
While stability has improved, crashes may still occur. If they persist, try switching from FSR to DLSS or TSR, and enable GPU Crash Debugging in the game’s settings to assist our investigation (note that this may impact performance). When the Unreal Crash Reporter appears, please include details of your actions leading up to the issue and click “Send to Madfinger.”

As we add new content for the upcoming Night Ops Update, we're also continuously working on fixing crashes and improving performance to ensure you have the best experience possible. 

We appreciate your support and welcome your participation in helping improve Gray Zone Warfare.

[h3][b]The FINAL Gray Zone Warfare Patch 2 PUBLIC TESTING is here. Thanks to your feedback, we have made numerous improvements to Patch 2 and added a major rubberbanding fix that we need to stress test with your help.[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]Patch 2 Testing Final Reprosteps Solo:[/b][/h3]

[i][b]Players in coma can't be shot:[/b][/i]

1. Join the PvEvP server (Warfare) in a squad or find a teammate
2. Player 1 shoots Player 2 until Player 2 falls into a Coma.
3. Player 1 kills Player 2 while he is in a Coma.
[b]Result:[/b] Player 2 should die after being shot while in Coma. If not, please mark what Player 2 was doing before falling into a coma and if they were able to skip coma and respawn?

[b][i]Lights inside buildings are flickering:[/i][/b]

1. Connect to the server 
2. Go to multiple buildings
3. Observe the behavior of the light
[b]Results:[/b] The light should not flicker.


[h3][b]Patch 2 Testing Final Reprosteps Squads:[/b][/h3]

[b][i]Squad VOIP issues:[/i][/b]

1. Invite at least 1 player into the squad.
2. Turn off the squad VOIP in audio settings.
3. Try to communicate through voice with other squad members.
4. Check that the player that has the VOIP turned off is unable to hear other party members and that other squad members are unable to hear that player.
[b]Result:[/b] A player should not hear other squad members, nor should they hear the player after deactivating squad VOIP. If that is not the case, please mark what you were doing before changing the settings.

[b][i]The Squad Leader is unable to invite a player to the squad after kicking them.[/i][/b]

1. In the lobby (Main Menu), Player 1 creates a Squad with Player 2.
2. Player 1 kicks Player 2 from the Squad.
3. Player 1 opens the Friends tab and attempts to invite to squad the Player 2 again.
[b]Result:[/b] Player 1 should be able to invite Player 2 back into the squad after kicking them. If not, please mark what happened before.

notes.title: GZW: Early Access & Beyond (Update)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44732938/f74a74637ef0e34ce31b01f0255e9ad3e0246296.png[/img]Hello, everyone! We've curated a comprehensive set of questions and answers, providing insights into what lies ahead in Early Access and beyond. Dive into the details below.

[h3][b]Why Early Access?[/b][/h3]
In Early Access, your active involvement shapes the development of Gray Zone Warfare.  At MADFINGER Games, we are eager to listen to our community's feedback and align with your expectations and preferences. We aim to create an environment that compels you to visit and engage with us daily. Let's make the ultimate tactical FPS experience together.

[h3][b]Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?[/b][/h3]
Gray Zone Warfare is a long-term project that will continue to evolve until we deliver the ultimate gaming experience. We will release regular updates featuring new content, expanding world-building, adding new weapons and gear, unveiling new quests and environmental storytelling, as well as optimizing and fixing bugs before concluding the Early Access phase. The approximate timeline may span several years, depending on community feedback and the fulfillment of our shared vision.

[h3][b]How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?[/b][/h3]
In the full version, expect an immersive tactical FPS sandbox where you must fully adapt to your surroundings and utilize tactics to your advantage.

[b]The planned state of the Full Release includes:[/b]
[list]
[*] A complete map featuring all locations and diverse biomes
[*] A hazardous Ground Zero area with end-game enemies and new storylines
[*] Different types of AI behaviors based on the enemy type, situation, time, or weather condition
[*] Faction-based AI with its own agenda involving quests, patrolling, scavenging, and attacking others
[*] Factions featuring progression systems and diverse reputations
[*] Immersive environmental storytelling featuring mature and engaging plots
[*] Advanced quest system encompassing both main and side storylines
[*] Game-changing, captivating seasonal events
[*] Resource-intensive and survival-focused crafting
[*] Dynamic weather changing the gameplay experience
[*] An accelerated day and night cycle
[*] Unique skills system based on the player's achievements, not grind
[*] Customizable "hooch" player's base quarters
[*] Enhanced weapon customizations
[*] Fully customizable gear
[*] Complex trading system for players
[/list]
... and other new features sparked by the input and desires of the community.

[h3][b]What is the current state of the Early Access version?[/b][/h3]
The Early Access version features an immersive tactical FPS sandbox as its alpha experience, signifying that all core features are included. We plan to continually enhance this foundation with additional content and feature updates.

[b]The planned state of the Early Access release includes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Three distinct PMC factions supporting up to 48 players in total, with a maximum of 16 players per faction
[*] The expansive 42 km² open world of Lamang, based on a real location, showcasing an unprecedented representation of a jungle
[*] Ruthless AI behavior, with hundreds of enemies reacting to the player's moves through the actions and emotions
[*] Complex external and terminal ballistics simulation for a realistic shooting experience
[*] Comprehensive simulation of realistic firearm recoil based on real-world data
[*] An innovative health system that intricately simulates even bodily cavities and damage effects
[*] A network of six unique vendors offering 150 quests in total
[*] Eight highly customizable weapons with over 400 interchangeable parts
[*] A diverse array of over 80 equipable gear items for tactical advantage.
[*] An engaging, interconnected player progression system
[*] Detailed character creation and extensive apparel customization options
[*] Formidable squads, allowing for up to four members for coordinated gameplay
[*] Integrated social features, including Friends, VOIP, and Messenger, for enhanced player interaction
[/list]
[h3][b]Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?[/b][/h3]
Yes. The price of the Early Access version will be lower than that of the final release. The final pricing has yet to be determined.

[h3][b]How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?[/b][/h3]
All community members are welcome to share feedback, reports, comments, and suggestions on the Gray Zone Warfare Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/grayzonewarfare]https://discord.gg/grayzonewarfare[/url]

As an Early Access member, you have the unique opportunity to help us build an excellent foundation for what we envision as a long-lasting, immersive tactical FPS experience.
